scope: OPM Body, ordinary Complete Face, Face rebuild, then Body rebuild on the retained Face

face_build.initial_run_status: Face Fit handoff, full build, undo/redo and reopen passed; subsequent Face rebuild failed bind-pre comparison and was repaired

face_rebuild.cause_and_fix: Surviving Face-part Skins and regenerated primary HeadSkin received new bindPreMatrix values when old Face joints were replaced under the OPM Body. The rebuild now stages existing Face-joint bind-pre values and restores them to matching new influences when Keep Skin Weights is enabled.

limits: The OPM Body source comparison still has four near-straight arm cases above the unchanged 1e-4 threshold.

The original MEL stages only one Skin per All Head geometry and does not retain separately edited Lip/Tongue layer weights; the original multi-layer rebuild also stops at Prep on the saved Maya 2024 input.
This batch does not cover all Include, Legacy, RigType or default model variants.
